name: Rendezvous
source:
Rendezvous is a short non-profit Visual Novel based on the Fantasy Webcomic 'Marionetta' written and illustrated by Míriam Bonastre Tur, hosted on Webtoon as a Webtoon Original series, and bears no affiliation with its creators.

This VN is made by fans for fans of the relationship between Julia and Sahed.  It takes place after the end of season 1 of the comic and its story tries to predict the events of future episodes, while adding unlikely scenarios that are still interesting to explore from a fan perspective. Be it friendship, misunderstanding, love or none of them, the paths will be decided by all of your choices.

[From [url=https://andrajosa.itch.io/rendezvous]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Rendezvous》是一部短篇非营利视觉小说，改编自Míriam Bonastre Tur创作和插画的奇幻网络漫画“Marionetta”，作为网络漫画原创系列在Webtoon上托管，与其创作者没有任何关系。

这个VN是由粉丝为朱莉娅和萨赫德关系的粉丝制作的。它发生在漫画第一季结束后，它的故事试图预测未来剧集的事件，同时添加不太可能的场景，但从粉丝的角度来看，这些场景仍然值得探索。无论是友情、误会、爱情还是没有，道路将由你的选择决定。

[来自[url=https://andrajosa.itch.io/rendezvous]itch.io[/url]]
